title: Decoding Memes: Benchmarking Narrative Role Classification across Multilingual and Multimodal Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the classification of narrative roles (Hero, Villain, Victim) in memes. While these roles are defined by moral archetypes, the research is an NLP/Vision benchmark for role detection and narrative framing analysis, not an evaluation of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical reasoning systems.
